crossRefs.note: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.
In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, in the cities of the South, in the land of Benjamin…
Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the…
He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
“ ‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the…
Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish to you an everlasting…
I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within…
If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”

translations.web: “I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
translations.bsb: I will make you pass under the rod and will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
